title: ctxloom canonical transcript record
description: One line of ~/.ctxloom/sessions/<harp>/persist/transcript.acp.jsonl. See docs/transcript-schema.md for the full design rationale (tough-cloud). Generated/maintained by hand alongside internal/transcript/record.go — the two must be kept in sync (see internal/transcript/schema_test.go).

v.description: Schema version. A reader encountering an unrecognized v must fail loud, never guess at the shape.

harp.description: The ctxloom session id — the authoritative key.

session_id.description: Engine-native ACP session id (agent.ChatSessionInfo.SessionID) — the resume handle. Absent until the session line has been observed.

seq.description: Monotonic per-transcript ordering key, starting at 0, no gaps.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC recorder receipt time (not an engine-reported timestamp).

kind.description: Discriminates which payload field is populated.

raw.description: OPTIONAL escape hatch: the original engine frame, when a capture path holds one and the ChatEvent mapping is lossy for it. The ChatEvent-driven Recorder never populates this; reserved for importers (plan S6) and future richer capture paths.

entryPayload.description: One agent.SessionEntry, field for field (minus Timestamp, which is the envelope's ts).

sessionPayload.description: One-time session metadata (agent.ChatSessionInfo minus SessionID, which is hoisted to the envelope).

completePayload.description: Turn-completion accounting (agent.TurnMeta), carried in FULL — a lossless superset, not a trimmed projection.

permissionPayload.description: A forwarded engine permission request (agent.PermissionRequest), field for field.

kind.description: ACP ToolCallKind vocabulary (execute|edit|delete|move|read|search|fetch|think|other). Advisory; distinct from the envelope's Record.kind.
